title: ExtractionOutput
description: Structured fields extracted from a raw support ticket. Output of the extraction LLM, input to the scoring LLM.

ticket_id.description: Pass-through identifier from the webhook payload. Not generated by the LLM.

language.description: Dominant language of the ticket body. Mixed-language tickets are tagged by dominant language; the LLM still reads all content regardless of mix.

intent.description: Primary intent. If a ticket spans multiple intents, pick the highest-stakes one (breakdown_emergency > complaint > warranty_claim > billing_question > repair_request > appointment_scheduling > appointment_confirmation > quote_request > other).

product_area.description: Which product or service area the ticket concerns.

sentiment.description: Overall emotional tone of the ticket sender.

addresses.description: Postal addresses mentioned in the ticket. Empty array if none.

phone_numbers.description: Phone numbers mentioned. Empty array if none.

order_ids.description: Order or service ticket IDs mentioned in the body. Empty array if none.

error_codes.description: Heating system error codes mentioned (e.g. 'F22', 'E03'). Empty array if none.

summary_de.description: Two-sentence summary in German, regardless of original ticket language.

summary_en.description: Two-sentence summary in English, regardless of original ticket language.
